prose: An investigation asked ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI Overviews 200 everyday questions that call for a statistic - a share, rate, average, count or cost stated as fact - and then followed the citations all the way down. The opening example: the claim that 44 percent of salespeople give up after one follow-up, a number whose trail says a lot about where AI-quoted statistics actually come from.
highlights: 200 numeric questions posed to five AI assistants
Method: follow each citation chain to its origin
Example: the '44% of salespeople give up after one follow-up' statistic
